entries.why: Defines the server-side arithmetic for adding, editing and deleting community reviews. It checks the existing sum, count and average before applying a delta so corrupt stored totals fail visibly rather than publishing an inaccurate rating. This helper is not yet connected to a write route.

Covers review creation, edits, deletion and invalid aggregate state. An edit mutation that failed to subtract the previous rating made this test fail, confirming that the test detects a double-counted rating.
Adds a shadcn gallery carousel and displays and filters published community ratings.
Checks gallery rendering and rating filtering in community discovery. This preserves coverage for discovery behavior as the feature evolves.
Validates and projects public rating summaries without exposing additional fields.
Checks valid, missing and malformed public rating summaries. This preserves coverage for discovery behavior as the feature evolves.
Adds tenant-member review reads and denies all client writes beneath community settings; server transactions own the review records and aggregate.
Rounds the server-maintained average to one decimal and validates persisted aggregate state before applying review deltas.
Tests rounded averages and subsequent changes alongside the create edit and delete aggregate invariants.
Provides authenticated review writes and paginated public projection while maintaining both aggregate documents transactionally.
Covers membership and admin refusals, validation, review changes, aggregate updates, and the public privacy projection.
Preserves the server-owned review aggregate when saving settings and regenerating a public community listing.
Checks that settings saves ignore submitted ratings and preserve the stored aggregate on the public listing.
Records the existing discovery routing test digest already present in this branch for the ownership guard.
